query: Recover prior RAG/long-term-memory survey and map the first four archetypes onto FateGear

sources.title: Codex thread: 调研主流RAG记忆系统
RAG 与长期记忆系统调研报告

notes: The first four archetypes are chat-plugin long-term memory, local file/workspace memory, production Memory API / Memory-as-a-Service, and temporal knowledge graph memory.

FateGear already has a render-stage non-authoritative VectorContextStore, InMemoryVectorContextStore, VectorMemory, KeeperNarrationRecord, NarrationPipeline, and validation that prevents vector memory from overriding committed runtime facts.

Recommended initial slice: upgrade current in-memory narration vector memory into a persisted, auditable, session/module-scoped memory repository before adding external API or temporal graph adapters.
Existing dirty worktree changes must be preserved; pipeline artifacts should be additive and scoped.
